authors: Delma FZ, Melchers WJG, Verweij PE, Buil JB
rank_policy: Explicit re-summary with ceiling ranks; not an attribution of the original authors' finite-sample convention.

use: Descriptive recorded fraction only; no clinical classification or population sampling claim.
